naive_42_wilcoxon.caveat: Manual exact values: one zero-difference cell (orthrus_CADETS ep7, 0.9999->0.9999 ceiling tie) is dropped by zero_method='wilcox', leaving n=41 all-positive deltas with full rank sum W+=861=41*42/2; one-sided exact = 2^-41 = 4.547e-13, two-sided = 9.095e-13. scipy method='exact' silently falls back to the normal approximation in the presence of zeros (hence the archived 2.425e-8 in this field was approx, not exact). CAVEAT: this 42-cell layer still assumes epoch-level independence, which the nested 6-run design does not provide; use cluster_level for inference.

wild_cluster_bootstrap_64.method: exhaustive Rademacher sign enumeration on the 6 cluster means (CGM 2008 / Canay et al. 2021, G=6 special case; no asymptotics, no MC error)

stratified_wilcoxon.p_two_sided_exact_note: 6 positive deltas + 1 zero (ep7 ceiling tie 0.9999->0.9999); dropped zero leaves n=6 all-positive, two-sided exact = 2*2^-6 = 0.03125. scipy auto fell back to approx (0.0277) due to the zero.

_correction_2026_10_20.why: scipy wilcoxon method='exact' silently falls back to the normal approximation when zero-difference cells are present; the archived 'exact' field 2.4249905341003518e-08 was the approximation, bit-identical to two_sided_approx. The manual exact two-sided value (n=41 all-positive, W+=861) is 9.094947017729282e-13, consistent with the already-corrected naive_42_wilcoxon segment.

writeup_recommendation.abstract_sentence: CA improves 41/42 checkpoints (97.6%); treating the 6 training runs as the independent unit (Kish DEFF=3.5, n_eff~12.1), 6/6 runs improve with cluster-exact sign p=0.0312 (wild cluster bootstrap, 64 exhaustive sign patterns, identical p); the 42-cell Wilcoxon p=1.2e-8 assumes epoch-level independence that the nested design does not provide and is reported only as descriptive.
notes: per-combo Bonferroni x6 leaves orthrus_CADETS above 0.05 (exact p x 6); Holm gives the same verdict
d=1.586 and r=1.00 remain valid as effect sizes; only the p-value's unit changes
